# Andreessen Horowitz

> > A leading venture capital firm investing across AI infrastructure, generative AI, and enterprise technology with specialized investment platforms and deep technical expertise.

Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) is a prominent venture capital firm focused on backing transformative technology companies. The firm operates specialized investment platforms and maintains deep expertise in AI infrastructure, enterprise applications, and long-term institutional wealth management.

## Key Topics

- AI infrastructure
- Generative AI
- Enterprise AI
- Venture capital
- Investment platforms
- LLM comparison
- Data agents
- Long-term strategy
- Institutional investing
- Wealth management
- Video editing
- Team expertise
- Investment announcements

## Investment Platforms

- [a16z Infra](https://a16z.com/infra): Specialized investment platform focused on AI infrastructure and generational computing shifts
- [a16z Perennial](https://a16z.com/perennial): Long-term wealth and institutional investment platform for sustained capital growth
